title: Davisson and Germer observed electron diffraction
summary: Their 1927 Nature paper reports electrons scattering from a nickel crystal like waves.
body: C. Davisson and L. H. Germer, "The Scattering of Electrons by a Single Crystal of Nickel" (Nature, 1927), reported diffraction of electrons. That result is experimental evidence that electrons show wave behavior in this setup. The v1 article's appeal to the double-slit experiment is a related teaching example; this card cites the 1927 crystal experiment that was actually published, not a generic classroom diagram.
